about:
A Fabric Place has operated a retail fabric store in Baltimore, Maryland since 1969. The business was founded in 1969 and has served the area for over five decades.

The store carries an extensive selection of designer fabrics for clothing, including lines from Kiton, Armani, Gucci, Loro Piana, Valentino, and Zegna. Inventory is sold by the yard, with pre-cut 2.5-yard lengths of Kiton cashmere/silk/linen blends offered at $550 each. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

The shop caters to garment makers, tailors, and individual sewists seeking high-end apparel textiles. Its focus on luxury designer brands positions it within the premium clothing and fashion fabric market.

The company emphasizes its long-standing presence and “incredible selection of fabrics for clothing” as a draw for customers visiting the Baltimore location.
